order_items_type_target_consistent.name: order_items_type_target_consistent
order_items_type_target_consistent.value:
("order_items"."item_type" = 'editor_subscription' AND "order_items"."plan_id" IS NOT NULL AND "order_items"."storage_plan_id" IS NULL AND "order_items"."plugin_id" IS NULL)
    OR ("order_items"."item_type" = 'storage_subscription' AND "order_items"."storage_plan_id" IS NOT NULL AND "order_items"."plan_id" IS NULL AND "order_items"."plugin_id" IS NULL)
    OR ("order_items"."item_type" = 'plugin' AND "order_items"."plugin_id" IS NOT NULL AND "order_items"."plan_id" IS NULL AND "order_items"."storage_plan_id" IS NULL)
    OR ("order_items"."item_type" = 'token_topup' AND "order_items"."plan_id" IS NULL AND "order_items"."storage_plan_id" IS NULL AND "order_items"."plugin_id" IS NULL)

plans_type_capability_consistent.name: plans_type_capability_consistent
plans_type_capability_consistent.value:
("plans"."plan_type" = 'free' AND "plans"."grants_agent_access" = false AND "plans"."uses_byom" = false)
    OR ("plans"."plan_type" = 'byom' AND "plans"."grants_agent_access" = true AND "plans"."uses_byom" = true)
    OR ("plans"."plan_type" = 'agent' AND "plans"."grants_agent_access" = true AND "plans"."uses_byom" = false)

plugin_entitlements_purchase_ownership.name: plugin_entitlements_purchase_ownership
plugin_entitlements_purchase_ownership.value: "plugin_entitlements"."source" <> 'purchase' OR ("plugin_entitlements"."subscription_id" IS NULL AND "plugin_entitlements"."expires_at" IS NULL)

plugins_free_price_null.name: plugins_free_price_null
plugins_free_price_null.value: "plugins"."is_paid" = true OR ("plugins"."price_minor" IS NULL AND "plugins"."currency" IS NULL)

plugins_paid_price_positive.name: plugins_paid_price_positive
plugins_paid_price_positive.value: "plugins"."is_paid" = false OR ("plugins"."price_minor" > 0 AND "plugins"."currency" IS NOT NULL)

token_lots_lock_consistent.name: token_lots_lock_consistent
token_lots_lock_consistent.value:
("token_lots"."locked_at" IS NULL AND "token_lots"."lock_expires_at" IS NULL AND "token_lots"."locked_tokens" = 0)
    OR ("token_lots"."locked_at" IS NOT NULL AND "token_lots"."lock_expires_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "token_lots"."lock_expires_at" = "token_lots"."locked_at" + interval '30 days'
        AND "token_lots"."locked_tokens" >= 0)

token_lots_lock_window_not_expired.name: token_lots_lock_window_not_expired
token_lots_lock_window_not_expired.value: "token_lots"."locked_at" IS NULL OR "token_lots"."expires_at" IS NULL OR "token_lots"."expires_at" >= "token_lots"."lock_expires_at"

token_lots_type_target_consistent.name: token_lots_type_target_consistent
token_lots_type_target_consistent.value:
("token_lots"."lot_type" = 'monthly_allowance' AND "token_lots"."subscription_period_id" IS NOT NULL AND "token_lots"."order_item_id" IS NULL AND "token_lots"."expires_at" IS NOT NULL)
    OR ("token_lots"."lot_type" = 'purchased_topup' AND "token_lots"."subscription_period_id" IS NULL AND "token_lots"."order_item_id" IS NOT NULL)

token_transactions_amount_matches_type.name: token_transactions_amount_matches_type
token_transactions_amount_matches_type.value:
("token_transactions"."transaction_type" IN ('grant', 'release', 'refund', 'adjustment', 'unlock') AND "token_transactions"."amount" > 0)
    OR ("token_transactions"."transaction_type" IN ('consume', 'lock', 'expire') AND "token_transactions"."amount" < 0)
    OR ("token_transactions"."transaction_type" = 'carry_forward' AND "token_transactions"."amount" <> 0)
